facts.fact: A National Computer Emergency Response Team is stated to exist as the body receiving incident reports under the newly enacted Proclamation No. 1426/2026, alongside INSA; the document gives no enactment date, so the publication date is used.

Proclamation No. 1426/2026 identifies 12 critical infrastructure sectors and requires their owners and operators to report cyber incidents to the National CERT within 48 hours, among 18 obligations; the publication date is used as no enactment date is given.
